description: QEMU mcimx6ul-evk stand-in for the PW4 (4.1.15, device tree, 2G/2G, SMP_ON_UP, RAM at 0x80000000): the loader-stage kernel loads the module and jumps to a QEMU build of the Android kernel; no device
identity_limit_why: as on the PW4: PAGE_OFFSET == PHYS_OFFSET, lowmem one to one to the end of the 512 MiB
